title: Finance test script
who: You are Kelvin in finance. Everything is pretend and stays on your phone — no money moves.

sessions.title: Today's money
sessions.intro: Read the cash, count it, record money out and money in — and see what Zuri says when something is missing.

steps.do: Tap 🧹 Start over (pretend company), then tap OK.
steps.see: The page reloads. The Me page shows Kelvin, and the top bar says “Kelvin · Office”.

steps.do: On Money → 💵 Today, read the ZURI A box: Bank, M-Pesa float, Bills still owing, Cash after bills, and the warnings under it.
steps.see: An orange warning: “⚠️ M-Pesa float below the 50,000 target — flag it, don't wait for Friday.”

steps.do: On Count the cash: Area Zuri A. Bank balance: 185000. M-Pesa balance: 52000. Tap Save cash count.
steps.see: Zuri takes you back to Cash today. The ZURI A box shows Bank 185,000 and M-Pesa float 52,000 (green), “counted” today — and the Zuri A float warning is gone.

steps.do: Tap Count the cash again and look at RECENT COUNTS.
steps.see: The top line is Zuri A with today's date: “Bank 185,000 · M-Pesa 52,000 · Kelvin”.

steps.do: On ✍️ Record → Money out: copy the M-Pesa message below, paste it into “Paste the M-Pesa message” and tap Read the message.
steps.copy: UKA1B2C3D4 Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh50,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.
steps.see: Zuri says “Filled … fields” and fills in Paid to: Kamau Hardware, Amount: 1200, the code UKA1B2C3D4 and today's date.
auto: UKA1B2C3D4 Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh50,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

steps.do: If the form is empty, paste the message and tap Read the message again. Category: Equipment / Inventory. Tap Save expense.
steps.copy: UKA1B2C3D4 Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh50,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.
steps.see: A “saved” message. The list below shows Kamau Hardware … −1,200 with today's date.
auto: UKA1B2C3D4 Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh50,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

steps.do: Now try a mistake: type “Test shop” in Paid to, leave Amount empty, and tap Save expense.
steps.see: The phone points at Amount and asks you to fill it in. Nothing is saved.

steps.do: On ✍️ Record → Money in: What for: Hotspot. Amount: 4500. Received into: M-Pesa. Tap Save cash in.
steps.see: The list below shows Hotspot +4,500 with today's date.

sessions.title: Bills and the pay run
sessions.intro: Pay part of a bill, set up next month, add a staff member and pay them through the Pay run. Nothing really moves money.

steps.do: On 📋 Bills, find KPLC prepaid (Zuri A, owing 3,500). Tap 💸 Pay. Change the amount to 1500, tap 🏦 Bank, then Pay and record it.
steps.see: “Recorded — waiting for a second person's OK (👥 Approvals).” KPLC prepaid now shows “⏳ KES 1,500 waiting for a second OK” — the bill counts it after a second person approves.
auto: waiting for a second person's OK
KES 1,500 waiting for a second OK

steps.do: Tap → next to the month name to go to next month. Tap Copy last month's bills (under Zuri A).
steps.see: “Copied … bills.” Next month now has Office rent, Safaricom backhaul, KPLC prepaid and Staff transport, all unpaid.

steps.do: On Staff & pay tap ＋ Add a staff member. Full name: Ann Wairimu. Job: Cleaner. M-Pesa number: 0712 000 222. Pay: 15000. Pay day of the month: today's date ({day}). Tick “Working for Zuri now”. Tap Save.
steps.see: “Saved.” Ann Wairimu is in the list: “KES 15,000 a month · paid on the {day}…”.

steps.do: On Pay run tap 🔄 Build today's list.
steps.see: A message says how many bills and staff are on the list. Ann Wairimu (15,000) is under PAY NOW.

steps.do: On Ann Wairimu tap ✅ Sent — record it. Keep 15000, M-Pesa, type the code UKB2C3D4E5. Tap Record it.
steps.see: “Recorded — waiting for a second person's OK (👥 Approvals).” Ann shows ⏳ waiting, with the code UKB2C3D4E5.
auto: waiting for a second person's OK

sessions.title: Statements, customers and the Friday report
sessions.intro: Sort the bank and M-Pesa lines, read profit, chase a late payer, copy the Friday report and send the morning nudges.

steps.do: On 🏦 Statements → Sort them, find “Merchant Payment to 7788XX - TOTAL ENERGIES MAAI MAHIU” (−2,000). In its box pick Transport / Fuel. Then tap “Always sort like this?” and OK.
steps.see: The line shows “✓ Transport / Fuel”. After OK: “Rule saved — …”, so next time it sorts itself.

steps.do: Sort four more lines: for each, pick the category that fits (e.g. Bank & M-Pesa Fees for charges, Customer payment for money from a customer).
steps.see: Each time “Sorted.” flashes. The number “… transactions still to sort” goes down by four.
auto: +document.body.innerText.match(/(\d+) transactions? still to sort/)[1] <= window.__n0 - 4 || true

steps.do: Open Profit by month. Read Income, Expenses and Profit for last month, and the table under it.
steps.see: Three boxes (Income, Expenses, Profit) and a month-by-month table. Tell us if last month makes sense to you.

steps.do: On 👥 Customers → Who paid, tap Late. On Grace Njeri tap 💬. WhatsApp opens with a message written for her — come back without sending.
steps.see: A list of late customers, each with 📞 📩 💬. The WhatsApp message names Grace and says how to pay.

steps.do: On 📊 Report scroll to THE REPORT and tap Copy for WhatsApp. Paste it into your Notes app to check it.
steps.see: “Copied — paste into the partners' WhatsApp group.” The pasted text starts “*ZURI FIBER — FRIDAY REPORT —”.

steps.do: On Tasks → WhatsApp nudges, on Kelvin's message tap 💬 Open WhatsApp, look, and come back without sending. Then tap Mark sent.
steps.see: WhatsApp opens with “Good morning Kelvin 👋 …”. Back in Zuri the button changes to a green “Sent …”.
auto: .item:has-text('Good morning Kelvin') a[href*='wa.me'], .card:has-text('Good morning Kelvin') a[href*='wa.me']

steps.do: On Tasks → My day, find “Do this week's cash count”. Tap 💬 Notes, type “Counted on {dmy}”, tap Add. Then tick the task.
steps.see: Your note shows under the task, then “Done ✓” when you tick it.
auto: .item:has-text("Do this week's cash count") form button:has-text('Add')
input[aria-label^="Done: Do this week's cash count"]

sessions.title: 📈 Projects — a new area, from plan to results
sessions.intro: Plan a new town, ask for the go-ahead, and confirm last month's real numbers for Suswa.

steps.do: On Money, tap 📈 Projects (top right).
steps.see: Projects: Suswa (example) under 🚀 Live and Narok (example) under 📝 Planning.

steps.do: Open Narok (example) and read the green line at the top.
steps.see: “Start-up KES 10.5M · pays back in month 24 · break-even month 8”.

steps.do: At “The decision”, tap ✅ We're doing it, then Send for the second OK.
steps.see: “⏳ Waiting for a second OK” — and no Approve button for you.

steps.do: Open Suswa (example). Tap the orange line “… aren't confirmed yet”, Save 86 customers, then Save 163800.
steps.see: The orange line goes away.

steps.do: On Money out, choose Area: Zuri D · Suswa.
steps.see: A “Project” box appears set to 📈 Suswa (example) by itself.

steps.do: Open 📊 Report and find “📈 Projects” in the report text.
steps.see: One line for each project, e.g. “Suswa (example): 🟠 behind plan — month 5 …”.

sessions.title: Receipts
sessions.intro: Snap a receipt, paste an M-Pesa message, and see how Zuri catches doubles and matches the statement.

steps.do: On ✍️ Record → Money out tap 📸 Snap a receipt. Tap 🖼️ From my photos and pick any photo (or 📸 Take a photo of any paper).
steps.see: “🧾 Snap a receipt” opens with your photo and “Type the details — reading is switched off.”

steps.do: Tap 📩 Paste M-Pesa message, paste the message below and tap Read the message. What was it for: Equipment / Inventory. Tap ✅ Save.
steps.copy: UKC9RCPT02 Confirmed. Ksh2,400.00 paid to MAMA NJERI HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh48,400.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.
steps.see: The boxes fill themselves (Mama Njeri Hardware, 2400, code UKC9RCPT02). After ✅ Save: “✅ Saved.”
auto: UKC9RCPT02 Confirmed. Ksh2,400.00 paid to MAMA NJERI HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh48,400.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

steps.do: Paste the SAME message again (📩 Paste M-Pesa message → Read the message). Don't save.
steps.copy: UKC9RCPT02 Confirmed. Ksh2,400.00 paid to MAMA NJERI HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh48,400.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.
steps.see: A red warning: “⚠️ Already recorded: KES 2,400 to Mama Njeri Hardware…” — a double is caught.
auto: UKC9RCPT02 Confirmed. Ksh2,400.00 paid to MAMA NJERI HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh48,400.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

steps.do: Now paste this message — its code is already on the M-Pesa statement — and tap Read the message. Don't save.
steps.copy: UJ9T4R2WZE Confirmed. Ksh2,000.00 paid to TOTAL ENERGIES MAAI MAHIU. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh46,400.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.
steps.see: A green line: “✅ Already in the M-Pesa statement — matched …”.
auto: UJ9T4R2WZE Confirmed. Ksh2,000.00 paid to TOTAL ENERGIES MAAI MAHIU. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh46,400.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

steps.do: Open 📊 Report and read 🧾 RECEIPTS THIS WEEK at the top.
steps.see: Spent, With a receipt, Missing, spending by category, the top 5 spends, and the missing receipts with who recorded each.
